preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 250,000.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= 10**6 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices and has a positive integer weight.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[x] <= sum(c for _, _, c in edges) for x in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer not greater than the total weight of all edges.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(c for a, b, c in edges if a == i or b == i) - output[i] <= i for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: After deleting the edges corresponding to output[i], the degree of each vertex is at most i.
